```{r setup}
# Every slide is ONE 960 x 720 "canvas" plot (same pixel size as the GIF), so
# the pie, the leader lines, the labels and the heading sit exactly where they
# do in the original frames.
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(showtext)

fam <- "sans"; fam_l <- "sans"
try({
  sysfonts::font_add_google("Open Sans", "os",       regular.wt = 400, bold.wt = 700)
  sysfonts::font_add_google("Open Sans", "os-light", regular.wt = 300)
  fam <- "os"; fam_l <- "os-light"
}, silent = TRUE)
showtext_auto(); showtext_opts(dpi = 100)

px <- function(p) p * 0.72 / ggplot2::.pt      # pixel font size -> geom size (mm)

# ---- Data and palette -------------------------------------------------------
cats  <- c("Food", "Energy", "Clothes", "Other")
share <- c(Food = 42, Energy = 14, Clothes = 12, Other = 32)
cols_multi <- c(Food = "#C0504D", Energy = "#B2A1C7", Clothes = "#9BBB59", Other = "#4F81BD")
gris <- "#7F7F7F"
cols_gray <- c(Food = "#C0504D", Energy = "#7F7F7F", Clothes = "#7F7F7F", Other = "#7F7F7F")
dark <- "#595959"
darken <- function(col, f) rgb(t(pmin(255, col2rgb(col) * f)), maxColorValue = 255)
side_f <- c(Food = .55, Energy = .6, Clothes = .72, Other = .42)

# ---- Pixel layout measured on the GIF (960 x 720) ---------------------------
lab <- tibble(
  meat  = factor(cats, levels = cats),
  share = unname(share[cats]),
  y     = c(309, 375, 441, 507),          # label / line / bar centre
  x0    = 254,                            # line start
  x1    = 254 + 7.9 * share              # length proportional to share
)

# Pie, clockwise from 12 o'clock: Food, Other, Clothes, Energy; first edge at -40.5 deg
pie_order <- c("Food", "Other", "Clothes", "Energy")
ang_w  <- share[pie_order] / 100 * 2 * pi
ang_0  <- -40.5 * pi / 180 + cumsum(c(0, head(ang_w, -1)))
ang_1  <- ang_0 + ang_w
names(ang_0) <- names(ang_1) <- pie_order

lerp <- function(a, b, t) a + (b - a) * t
# t = 0: original 3D pie (tilted ellipse + side wall); t = 1: flat circle
pie_par <- function(t) list(
  cx = lerp(531, 513, t), cy = lerp(414, 418, t),
  a  = lerp(221, 178, t), b  = lerp(151, 178, t),
  vx = lerp(528, 513, t), vy = lerp(401, 418, t),
  d  = lerp(62, 0, t))

wedge_poly <- function(m, p, n = 80) {
  th <- seq(ang_0[[m]], ang_1[[m]], length.out = n)
  tibble(meat = m,
         x = c(p$vx, p$cx + p$a * sin(th)),
         y = c(p$vy, p$cy - p$b * cos(th)))
}
side_poly <- function(m, p, n = 40, strips = 8) {   # visible front wall (angles 90-270)
  lo <- max(ang_0[[m]], pi / 2); hi <- min(ang_1[[m]], 3 * pi / 2)
  if (p$d <= 0 || hi <= lo) return(NULL)
  th  <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = n)
  top <- tibble(x = p$cx + p$a * sin(th), y = p$cy - p$b * cos(th))
  map_dfr(seq_len(strips), function(j) {
    y_a <- (j - 1) / strips * p$d;  y_b <- j / strips * p$d      # y grows downward
    bind_rows(mutate(top, y = y + y_a),
              mutate(arrange(top, desc(row_number())), y = y + y_b)) |>
      mutate(meat = m, strip = j,
             shade = lerp(1.35, 0.65, (j - 0.5) / strips))      # light top -> dark bottom
  })
}

title_html <- function(gray = FALSE) {
  if (gray) return("<b style='color:#7F7F7F'>Household expenditure</b>")
  paste0("<b><span style='color:#E36C0A'>Household</span> ",
         "<span style='color:#8064A2'>expenditure</span> ",
         "<span style='color:#F20000'>categories</span></b>")
}

canvas <- function() {
  ggplot() +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_y_reverse(limits = c(720, 0), expand = c(0, 0)) +   # pixel y grows DOWNWARD
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 960), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
}

add_heading_footer <- function(g, heading) {
  g +
    annotate("text", x = 60, y = 88, label = heading, hjust = 0,
             size = px(62), colour = "#404040", family = fam_l) +
    annotate("text", x = 180, y = 693, hjust = 0, size = px(15), colour = gris,
             family = fam,
             label = "Recreated from \u201cRemove to improve\u201d by Darkhorse Analytics")
}

# ---- One frame of the GIF ---------------------------------------------------
frame <- function(heading,
                  outer = "none",              # "cyan" | "white" | "line" | "none"
                  inner = "none",              # "gray" | "none"
                  legend = FALSE,              # coloured legend squares
                  border = "white",            # wedge outline colour
                  t = 0,                       # 0 = 3D ... 1 = flat
                  keep = cats,                 # wedges still drawn
                  fills = cols_multi,
                  bold = rep(TRUE, 4),         # Food, Energy, Clothes, Other
                  title_gray = FALSE,
                  bar_h = 0,                   # >0: lines have become bars
                  red_Food = FALSE,
                  lines = TRUE) {
  g <- canvas()

  if (outer != "none") {
    g <- g + annotate("rect", xmin = 87, xmax = 881, ymin = 171, ymax = 670,
                      fill = c(cyan = "#AEE2EC", white = "white", line = NA)[[outer]],
                      colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
    if (outer == "cyan") {
      set.seed(7)
      drops <- tibble(x = runif(260, 95, 873), y = runif(260, 178, 663),
                      s = runif(260, 1.5, 6))
      g <- g + geom_point(data = drops, aes(x, y, size = s), shape = 21,
                          fill = "#D2F1F7", colour = "#8FD0DE", alpha = .7,
                          show.legend = FALSE) + scale_size_identity()
    }
  }
  if (inner == "gray") {
    g <- g + annotate("rect", xmin = 140, xmax = 829, ymin = 247, ymax = 640,
                      fill = "#BFBFBF", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
  }

  if (length(keep) > 0) {
    p <- pie_par(t)
    sides  <- map_dfr(keep, side_poly, p = p)
    wedges <- map_dfr(keep, wedge_poly, p = p)
    if (nrow(sides) > 0) {
      sides$col <- pmap_chr(list(as.character(sides$meat), sides$shade),
                            ~ darken(fills[[..1]], side_f[[..1]] * ..2))
      g <- g + geom_polygon(data = sides, aes(x, y, group = interaction(meat, strip), fill = col, colour = col),
                            linewidth = 0.3)       # same-colour outline hides seams between strips
      if (border != "white") {            # keep the dark outline of the early frames
        g <- g + geom_path(data = sides |> filter(strip == 8), aes(x, y, group = meat),
                           colour = border, linewidth = 1)
      }
    }
    wedges$col <- fills[wedges$meat]
    g <- g + geom_polygon(data = wedges, aes(x, y, group = meat, fill = col),
                          colour = border, linewidth = 1, linejoin = "round")
  }

  if (bar_h > 0) {
    bars <- lab |> mutate(col = if (red_Food) ifelse(meat == "Food", cols_multi[["Food"]], gris) else gris)
    g <- g + geom_rect(data = bars, aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x1, ymin = y - bar_h / 2,
                                        ymax = y + bar_h / 2, fill = col))
  } else if (lines) {
    g <- g + geom_segment(data = lab, aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y),
                          colour = "#404040", linewidth = 0.3)
  }

  if (legend) {
    sq <- lab |> mutate(col = cols_multi[as.character(meat)])
    g <- g + geom_rect(data = sq, aes(xmin = 161, xmax = 186, ymin = y - 12.5,
                                      ymax = y + 12.5, fill = col))
  }

  lab2 <- lab |> mutate(face = ifelse(bold, "bold", "plain"))
  g <- g +
    geom_text(data = lab2, aes(x = 196, y = y, label = meat, fontface = face),
              hjust = 0, size = px(18), colour = "black", family = fam) +
    geom_text(data = lab2, aes(x = x1 + 9, y = y, label = paste0(share, "%")),
              hjust = 0, size = px(17), colour = "#404040", family = fam) +
    geom_richtext(data = tibble(x = 195, y = 213, label = title_html(title_gray)),
                  aes(x, y, label = label), hjust = 0, fill = NA, label.colour = NA,
                  label.padding = unit(rep(0, 4), "pt"), size = px(36), family = fam)

  add_heading_footer(g, heading)
}

# ---- Title cards ------------------------------------------------------------
intro_card <- function() {
  canvas() +
    annotate("text", x = 90,  y = 250, label = "Remove", hjust = 0, size = px(118),
             fontface = "bold", colour = "#404040", family = fam) +
    annotate("text", x = 218, y = 328, label = "to", hjust = 0, size = px(46),
             colour = "#404040", family = fam_l) +
    annotate("text", x = 296, y = 335, label = "improve", hjust = 0, size = px(88),
             colour = "#404040", family = fam_l) +
    geom_richtext(data = tibble(x = 88, y = 400,
                                label = "the <b>pie chart</b> edition"),
                  aes(x, y, label = label), hjust = 0, fill = NA, label.colour = NA,
                  label.padding = unit(rep(0, 4), "pt"), size = px(46),
                  colour = "#C0504D", family = fam_l)
}
less_more <- function(word) {
  canvas() +
    annotate("text", x = 170, y = 262, label = "Less", hjust = 0, size = px(100),
             colour = "#404040", family = fam_l) +
    annotate("text", x = 178, y = 330, label = "is", hjust = 0, size = px(32),
             colour = "#404040", family = fam_l) +
    annotate("text", x = 232, y = 340, label = "more", hjust = 0, size = px(108),
             fontface = "bold", colour = "#404040", family = fam) +
    annotate("text", x = 236, y = 405, label = paste0("(", word, ")"), hjust = 0,
             size = px(36), colour = "#C0504D", family = fam_l)
}
```





```{r}
intro_card()
```
